# S02: Discovery Feed

**Goal:** agent.drip.surf/feed displays autonomous agent research entries persisted in Vercel KV, generated by a Vercel Cron job.
**Demo:** Visit /agent/feed → see research cards (company profiles) rendered with the DRIP design system. The cron endpoint at /api/cron/feed accepts authenticated GET requests, runs an autonomous agent via `generateText` with the research skill, and saves results to KV.

## Must-Haves

- `FeedEntry` type with KV read/write operations (sorted set for ordering, individual keys for data)
- Cron endpoint authenticated via `CRON_SECRET`, running `generateText` with research skill tools, saving results to KV
- `vercel.json` cron configuration (daily at 08:00 UTC)
- Feed page as server component rendering entries as Card grid with Badge + FadeInStagger
- Graceful degradation when KV is unavailable (empty state, not crash)
- `force-dynamic` or `revalidate` on feed page to pick up new entries

## Proof Level

- This slice proves: integration (cron → agent → KV → render)
- Real runtime required: yes (KV connection for full proof; graceful degradation for local dev)
- Human/UAT required: no (visual consistency with M001 is a milestone-level UAT concern in S03)

## Verification

- `bash scripts/verify-m002-s02.sh` — contract checks: file existence, exports, dependencies, build success, route compilation
- Feed page at `/agent/feed` renders without error (empty state when KV not connected)
- Cron endpoint returns 401 without valid `CRON_SECRET` header
- `npm run build` completes with zero errors

## Observability / Diagnostics

- Runtime signals: `[cron-feed]` console prefix on cron endpoint (topic selection, agent run start/finish, KV write, errors). `[feed]` prefix on KV operations.
- Inspection surfaces: cron endpoint returns JSON body with entry ID on success, error details on failure. Feed page renders entry count.
- Failure visibility: cron endpoint catches generateText failures and returns structured error JSON (topic, error message, phase). KV connection failures produce empty state on feed page with diagnostic message in server logs.
- Redaction constraints: none (no secrets in feed data)

## Integration Closure

- Upstream surfaces consumed: `lib/x402-client.ts` (payment fetch), `lib/skills/registry.ts` + `lib/skills/research.ts` (agent tools), `app/agent/layout.tsx` (shared layout), `components/ui/card.tsx` + `components/ui/badge.tsx` + `components/animation/fade-in-stagger.tsx` (UI)
- New wiring introduced: `@vercel/kv` dependency, KV data layer (`lib/feed.ts`), cron route, feed server component
- What remains before the milestone is truly usable end-to-end: S03 (wallet balance display, in-character error messages, modular skill proof)
